name: Launch kit
description: What a finished thing needs to reach people: the store listing within each store's limits, screenshots at the sizes stores ask for, a release video and a web page. Nothing is put online.
agent: Launching: launch_status, launch_listing (store text, checked against each store's limits), launch_screenshot (a page or picture at a store's exact size, with a caption if wanted), launch_site (a one-page site from the listing). Everything goes in launch/; never publish anything without asking.

intro.tagline: Everything you need to show a finished thing to the world.
intro.what: When something is finished and you want people to find it (say, putting the phone app in the Google Play store), you need more than the app: words for the store page, screenshots at the exact sizes the store wants, maybe a short video, and a web page about it. This makes all of those. Nothing goes online until you decide.
helps: Store text is checked against each store’s rules as you write.
Screenshots come out at exactly the right size, with captions.
A good-looking web page made from the same words and pictures.
intro.example: Like a bake sale: the app is the cake, and this makes the sign, the photo and the poster that get people to try it.
